description: a young slavic huntress for hire, long black hair in a loose braid with a grey feather, freckles, sharp green eyes, a hooded moss-green cape over a leather jerkin, a quiver of fletched arrows on her back, leather trousers and soft boots, a wooden longbow in her hand, seen from the side, facing and walking to the right, upright mid-step in the pose of the grey mannequin, the same size and place as the mannequin, the whole figure from the top of the head to the feet inside the image, isolated figure on a plain background, forest fantasy

references.usage: the character's look: face, hair, clothes, colours and what the hands hold
the pose, size and place of the figure: seen from the side, facing right, upright mid-step; copy it exactly
